nodes.label: Module B — CRM, subscriptions & commercial agreements
Module I — Creative, approvals & client requests
Module N — Documents, media & identity documents
users
nodes.rationale: Recently changed (T-6, D-022, 26 Oct 2026): credentials, OTP and authenticator codes live in Amazon Cognito; users keeps identity_subject (Cognito sub) instead of password_hash and mfa_secret_ref; mfa_enabled mirrors Cognito.

nodes.label: audit events
nodes.rationale: Append-only, partitioned by month (A-15); records create/update/delete/approve/share/export/restricted_read; project_id denormalised for project-scoped reads.

nodes.label: payments
nodes.rationale: One table serves subscription receipts, milestone receipts, vendor payouts and refunds via direction + counterparty; client_visible true only for inbound client payments (A-4).

nodes.label: invoices
nodes.rationale: Split by direction (issued_to_client / received_from_vendor / received_from_hotel) rather than dual amount columns, closing the GP-17 leak path.

nodes.label: comments
nodes.rationale: Single polymorphic table (entity_type/entity_id) for designs, proposals, menus, requests, tasks, incidents, enquiries; is_internal hides from client. §21.4 flags splitting vs one-table trade-off.

nodes.label: guests
nodes.rationale: The atomic unit (GP-13): headcounts come from guest_function_attendance rows, not a party_count; children and accompanying members are real rows.

nodes.label: Conventions (§1): keys, standard columns, money, statuses, visibility
nodes.rationale: UUID v7 PKs, FKs named <table_singular>_id, numeric(14,2) money with currency, soft-delete standard columns on every table; statuses are fixed enums because automation depends on them.

nodes.label: Visibility markers & enum (RESTRICTED / SENSITIVE / CLIENT)
nodes.rationale: documents.visibility & media_assets.visibility are enums (internal/client/guest/public/demo); other records follow the owning record; API enforces on every request and export.

nodes.label: Soft delete (deleted_at); wedding/guest/finance never hard-deleted
nodes.rationale: Physical deletion only through retention jobs (A-17).

nodes.label: Polymorphic references (owner_type/entity_type/record_type + id)
nodes.rationale: Used only for documents, media, comments, approvals, audit events and notifications; carry a check constraint on allowed types.

nodes.label: Demo isolation (A-28): is_demo / demo_visible at repository layer
nodes.rationale: Demo users scoped to is_demo accounts/projects and demo_visible hotels at the repository layer, not the interface.

nodes.label: Module entitlement resolution (GP-1)
nodes.rationale: Active/trial subscription grants plan_modules; active service_agreement grants its service module; active project_members grants wedding_workspace regardless of subscription.

nodes.label: Versioned, immutable records; approvals lock exact versions
nodes.rationale: design_versions, menu_versions, invitation_versions, vendor_proposals, hotel_proposals are immutable once shared; a new version supersedes and requires a new approval (SPEC §12).

nodes.label: Separate client-facing vs internal cost/margin columns (A-4)
nodes.rationale: Client-facing and internal amounts are always separate columns, never one column with a flag; internal cost/margin never serialised to a client session.

nodes.label: Retention & residency (A-8, A-17): no auto-deletion, AMPM-approved
nodes.rationale: retention_class/retention_until on documents & identity_documents; AMPM decided no automatic deletion — jobs produce proposed deletion lists awaiting approval; all personal data stays in India (A-14).

nodes.label: Single tenant (A-30): no organisation_id anywhere
nodes.rationale: For AMPM internal use; adding organisation_id later to license the software is expensive to retrofit.

nodes.label: Amazon Cognito identity service (T-6, D-022, Mumbai)
nodes.rationale: Credentials, OTP and authenticator codes live in Amazon Cognito (Mumbai); users.identity_subject holds the Cognito sub; auth_tokens remains only for invitation/link tokens the API mints. Implemented in apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma.

nodes.label: users.identity_subject column (Cognito sub)
nodes.rationale: Unique; the identity service's subject (Cognito sub); null until activated. Replaces password_hash on users.

nodes.label: Assumption A-1 (Q1)
nodes.rationale: Native iOS & Android apps with offline use from launch; browser for public website (changed 2026-10-26)

nodes.label: Assumption A-2 (Q2)
nodes.rationale: Online payment only (card/UPI via Razorpay); client enters basic wedding details before paying; no refund (changed)

nodes.label: Assumption A-3 (Q3)
nodes.rationale: Rs 50,000 one-time, one month, configurable; renewal is a new purchase; demo serves as trial (confirmed)

nodes.label: Assumption A-4 (Q4)
nodes.rationale: Internal cost & margin never shown; client-facing vs internal amounts in separate columns (partly decided)

nodes.label: Assumption A-5 (Q5)
nodes.rationale: Two family representatives, one per side, equal rights; email+mobile verified, countersigned (changed)

nodes.label: Assumption A-6 (Q6)
nodes.rationale: Department-based staff roles plus external roles; cost visibility by role (partly decided)

nodes.label: Assumption A-7 (Q7)
nodes.rationale: RSVP links per side or one combined; guests self-identify; no editing after submission; corrections via RSVP team (changed)

nodes.label: Assumption A-8 (Q8)
nodes.rationale: Identity docs only when enabled (hotel check-in); no Aadhaar; restricted bucket; retention per AMPM policy (partly)

nodes.label: Assumption A-9 (Q9)
nodes.rationale: Indicative price ranges incl. wedding package ranges & per-plate; street view; ~200 hotels at start (confirmed)

nodes.label: Assumption A-10 (Q10)
nodes.rationale: First release scope: discovery, wedding mgmt, vendors, portal, dept access, RSVP, requests, live chat, offline; single go-live (changed)

nodes.label: Assumption A-11 (Q11)
nodes.rationale: Channels in-app, email, WhatsApp (SMS fallback); live chat added (partly decided)

nodes.label: Assumption A-12 (Q12)
nodes.rationale: No website editing in the app; Module P retained dormant (dropped)

nodes.label: Assumption A-13 (Q13)
nodes.rationale: Clients verified by email+mobile, sign in with mobile OTP; staff password + authenticator; identity service Cognito (changed)

nodes.label: Assumption A-14 (Q14)
nodes.rationale: Hosted on AMPM VPS (Hostinger KVM 4, Mumbai); backups/files in Mumbai S3; data stays in India (changed)

nodes.label: Assumption A-15 (Q15)
nodes.rationale: Sizing changed: ~200 hotels, 20 concurrent weddings; staff/guest capacity TBC

nodes.label: Assumption A-16 (Q16)
nodes.rationale: Single currency INR, English; platform does not issue GST invoices, so GST fields dormant (confirmed)

nodes.label: Assumption A-17 (Q17)
nodes.rationale: No automatic deletion; retention & deletion require AMPM approval; periods TBC (changed)

nodes.label: Assumption A-18 (Q18)
nodes.rationale: A wedding may use several hotels (project_hotels) and external venues; primary_hotel_id is convenience only (confirmed)

nodes.label: Assumption A-19 (Q19)
nodes.rationale: Room blocks per project/hotel/category/date range; team-managed allocation; person-wise counts incl. children (confirmed)

nodes.label: Assumption A-20 (Q20)
nodes.rationale: Live chat required alongside tracked requests — new Module Q (changed)

nodes.label: Assumption A-21 (Q21)
nodes.rationale: Change requests are client_requests of type change_request; closed status added (confirmed)

nodes.label: Assumption A-22 (Q22)
nodes.rationale: Vendors and hotels never log in; users.user_type has no vendor value (confirmed)

nodes.label: Assumption A-23 (Q23)
nodes.rationale: Three months read-only client access after closure, then archive on AMPM approval (changed)

nodes.label: Assumption A-24 (Q24)
nodes.rationale: Post-wedding feedback is a client_feedback row; archived state on wedding_projects (confirmed)

nodes.label: Assumption A-25 (Q25)
nodes.rationale: A change is material when it exceeds configurable thresholds; sets is_material + impact_flags_json (partly decided)

nodes.label: Assumption A-26 (AM-3)
nodes.rationale: functions.status and functions.readiness_status are two fields; readiness derived from checklist (confirmed)

nodes.label: Assumption A-27 (AM-5)
nodes.rationale: hotel_room_categories.room_count is inventory; max_occupancy is per room (stands)

nodes.label: Assumption A-28 (AM-8)
nodes.rationale: Demo data isolated by is_demo/demo_visible; demo after OTP, three locations, one real hotel each (changed)

nodes.label: Assumption A-29 (AM-9)
nodes.rationale: A subscription belongs to an account and covers every project on it (stands)

nodes.label: Assumption A-30 (AM-14)
nodes.rationale: Single tenant (AMPM only); no organisation_id column anywhere (confirmed)
